target_rule.rule_name: Heavy TCP Host Scan On Fixed Port

issue_a_policy_state.problem: v7 Approved but GUI displayed No Active Version and False Revocation/Suspension
issue_a_policy_state.root_cause: Test fixture teardown deleted ephemeral versions leaving active_version_id dangling, and UI conflated null binding with security suspension
issue_a_policy_state.fix: Hardened test teardown to scoped deletions, added safe activate_approved_version endpoint, corrected activePolicyLabel to distinguish null binding from revocation

issue_b_evaluation_tracking.problem: AI Evaluation Tracking showed 0 total incidents despite 37 incidents existing
issue_b_evaluation_tracking.root_cause: AisEvaluationService defaulted customer to 'DEFAULT', excluding multi-tenant FortiSIEM incidents in 'GDC_NOC' and 'Demo-SOC'
issue_b_evaluation_tracking.fix: Multi-tenant bypass for admin users in ais_evaluation_service.py and ais_evaluation.py

issue_c_evidence_mapping.problem: Review Incidents normalized evidence table displayed '-' for source IP, timestamp, port, host
issue_c_evidence_mapping.root_cause: Field key mismatch ('field'/'value' vs 'source_field'/'observed_value') and lack of fallback for header-only incidents
issue_c_evidence_mapping.fix: Canonical evidence mapping aligned to source_field and canonical_field with automatic fallback to incident top-level metadata

issue_d_navigation_simplification.problem: Excessive multi-level nested navigation confusing operational SOC analysts
issue_d_navigation_simplification.root_cause: Fragmented layout across reviewSubView, activeViewMode, 9 separate config sections, and legacy 7-tab view
issue_d_navigation_simplification.fix: Consolidated into 3 operational tabs (Tab 1: Incidents, Tab 2: AI Evaluation, Tab 3: Accuracy) + 1 Administrative Settings control with 10 modules
